notes.title: Update Notes 8/30/2021
notes.content: Changes to enemy behaviors. Hopefully providing a less predictable gameplay experience.

notes.title: Update Notes 8/29/2021
notes.content:
Added "Win Zones" to playfield at certain wave numbers. (waves 5/10/15... and so on.) If players can survive through wave 25, the game is considered "Won" as well. 

FUTURE - New AI navigation overhaul is in the works. Stay tuned for updates related to that as well!

notes.title: Update Notes 8/27/2021
notes.content: Added a spatial compass above the players. This can be toggled on and off using the default "M" key. When the "Insane Animals Remaining" count is less than 5, the compass is also updated with enemy locations in real time. This will help with finding those pesky remaining animals that would rather hide than eat you.

notes.title: Update Notes 8/26/2021
notes.content: Small update to add some visual FX feedback to some animal attack patterns. If this works well, I will implement more of these effects to other animals in the near future. I also added a couple of tool tips at the beginning of play to alert the player of key bindings for flashlight and flare functions.

notes.title: Update Notes 8/25/2021
notes.content: Fixed a sound related bug where the flamethrower was being heard by all players at 100% volume regardless of distance.
